name: agent-dispatch
description: Portable durable agent task-loop + per-host coordinator. A single-writer, WAL-mode SQLite work queue with an eight-state model (proposed/queued/claimed/started/suspended/completed/abandoned/dead_letter), capability-gated atomic claim, affinity routing, and liveness-reconciled recovery (actively held tasks garbage-collected against live workers, no lease TTL) -- so full-auto agents coordinate without origin/master push latency or a dedicated account per agent. Tasks are graduated context-handoffs (prompt + Markdown payload).
